at_rate.description: What it is worth at the rate, under RND-FX.

carrying.description: Its carrying amount in the base currency, at the invoices' own rates (ENG-14).

fx_rate.description: Base currency per one unit on the day, from the rate cascade (ENG-40); absent when it has none.

missing.description: Why there is no rate (FX-01), when the cascade has none for the day.
examples: No exchange rate for USD on 2026-10-31

unrealised.description: The unrealised gain (positive) or loss (negative): at the rate less the carrying amount; what the month-end revaluation would post before any earlier run (FR-GL-04).
